goal: Clean up the new PDF viewer's UI/UX and restore glass effects + springy animations.
goal_source: interactive query from human ('interface is trash ... no ai slop ... revert back animations and glass effects')
last_actions: 2026-11-24: Reviewed the new OptimizedPDFViewer chrome: too many docks (top-left, title, top-right with 8 buttons, markup row, transient page HUD, sidebar island, mobile dock) and a white action pill.

Simplified: removed the duplicate bottom page HUD (prev/next moved into the title dock); top-right dock reduced to zoom + search + more, with bookmark/markup/search moved into the More menu; mobile dock reduced to pages/markup/more. Replaced the white pill with neutral glass.
Rebuilt .pdv-g glass: soft vertical falloff, hairline rim, deeper shadow, 22px saturate blur. Tightened the title dock spacing.

Restored the lively springs/squash in cbVideoPlayer and the preview dock (JELLY 520/15, POP 380/17, overshoot velocities, rubber 96, hover 1.045) while keeping the plain-CSS wide-screen dock anchoring fix.
blockers: No local tsc; Vercel cloud build authoritative (build passed).
next: Await visual feedback on the simplified PDF docks and restored motion.
